item.title: The Hidden Complexity of Analyzing Agent-User Conversations
item.description: While standard SQL queries and basic LLM tagging work for small datasets, extracting accurate feedback from agent logs breaks down at scale due to attribution challenges, agent framing bias, and rapidly shifting session sentiment. Quote: the hard part isn't extracting quotes, it's attribution – separating what the user actually felt from the agent's own framing, and sentiment that flips inside one session.

item.title: Why organizing knowledge in the age of AI sucks, and how I solve it
Why Jurassic Park's Tech Aged So Well
item.description: The enduring visual appeal of Jurassic Park is anchored in its commitment to absolute authenticity. By featuring real hardware like the Thinking Machines CM-5, actual Macintosh Programmer's Workshop source code, and genuine physical prototypes instead of relying on CGI fakes, the filmmakers respected the audience's sophistication and created a timeless aesthetic. Quote: I don't think it would have aged nearly as well as it has if more CGI (or other ways of 'faking' things) had been been used.
